SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 4117
Date 14 / 10 / 32

October 13, 32.

Acting Consul-General,
Consulate-General of the Netherlands,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of your
No.2821 of October 12 in reference to the loss of a
Netherlands passport by one B.J. Merter, and, in reply,
to inform that the matter will receive attention.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔此处转录不清〕 F. W. Gerrard
Commissioner of Police.

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 2821.

SHANGHAI, 12 October 1932.
（手写批注：N 4117 / 10 32）

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that at the end of
January of this year the Netherlands sailor Barend Johannes
HERTOG, born at Rotterdam, 14 January 1906, was signed off
at this port from the Danish s.s. "Niel Maersk", stayed for
a while in Shanghai in the Hanbury Institute, but afterwards
through arrangements made with the Captain of the above
vessel, returned to that ship again and left Shanghai,
however without reporting his departure to this Consulate
General.

Whilst here he showed a certificate of identity, issued
by the Netherlands Consulate General at New York on 8
December 1931.

I am now in receipt of a letter from Rotterdam, written
by the said Hertog to the effect that during his stay in
Shanghai he lost his wallet, containing his passport (pro-
bably the above certificate), some portraits and papers.

In case any lost property of this kind has been brought
to your notice I will be glad to hear from you.

On the other hand you might be interested to know of
the loss of Hertog's papers, as it is not unlikely that
third persons make unauthorized use thereof.

I forwarded a copy of this letter to the French Police.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

（签名）
Acting Consul-General.

The Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,

SHANGHAI.

（左侧边缘手写批注）：
C. 5
Answered -
D.I.S.

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA

第 2821 号。

上海，1932年10月12日。
（手写批注：N 4117 / 10 32）

先生：

谨此告知，今年一月底，荷兰籍海员 Barend Johannes HERTOG，1906年1月14日出生于鹿特丹，在本港从丹麦商船“Niel Maersk”号上解职离船，曾在上海的汉伯里研究所（Hanbury Institute）停留一段时间，但随后通过与上述船只船长作出的安排，再次返回该船并离开上海，然而并未向本总领事馆报告其离境情况。

在此期间，他出示了一份身份证明书，该证明书由荷兰驻纽约总领事馆于1931年12月8日签发。

本人现收到一封来自鹿特丹的信件，系上述 Hertog 所写，称其在上海停留期间丢失了钱包，内含其护照（可能是上述证明书）、一些照片及文件。

若此类失物已引起贵方注意，本人将乐于获悉。

另一方面，贵方或许也有兴趣知悉 Hertog 文件丢失一事，因为第三方未经授权擅自使用这些文件的可能性并非不存在。

本人已将此信副本转交法国巡捕房。

此致
敬礼

（签名）
代理总领事。

致：
上海工部局警务处处长，

上海。

C. 5
已回复 -
